Supplier contract risk review.overall: The contract falls short of the policy on payment terms and is missing a liability cap.

findings.contract_says: The Contractor will invoice at the end of each month and the Client will pay within 21 days.
findings.note: Payment is due within 21 days, sooner than the 30 days the policy asks for.
The contract does not limit the supplier's liability.

findings.contract_says: The Contractor will hold public liability insurance of at least £5 million.
findings.note: The supplier must hold public liability insurance of at least £5 million.

findings.contract_says: The contract runs from month to month until either party ends it, which either party may do by giving one calendar month's notice in writing.
findings.note: It continues from month to month, and the customer can end it with one month's notice, within the policy's three months.
Nothing in the contract shows the supplier handling personal data.
